# Rangel Janitorial

> Commercial cleaning and janitorial services for California businesses, with regional teams serving Sacramento, Murrieta and the Inland Empire, and Walnut Creek and the East Bay.

## Business information

- **Website:** https://rangeljanitorial.com
- **Headquarters:** 26323 Jefferson Ave Suite C, Murrieta, CA 92562
- **Email:** ralph@rangeljanitorial.com
- **Phones:** Sacramento (916) 426-2311 · Murrieta (951) 894-4222 · Walnut Creek (925) 655-9008
- **Office hours:** Contact the regional office to confirm current office hours and cleaning availability.

## Services

- [Janitorial Cleaning](https://rangeljanitorial.com/services/janitorial-cleaning)
- [Day Porter](https://rangeljanitorial.com/services/day-porter)
- [Electrostatic Disinfection](https://rangeljanitorial.com/services/electrostatic-disinfection)
- [Floor Care](https://rangeljanitorial.com/services/floor-care)
- [Office Cleaning](https://rangeljanitorial.com/services/office-cleaning)

- [Sacramento — Sacramento region](https://rangeljanitorial.com/locations/sacramento): (916) 426-2311
